questions.question: If A = 2(sin⁶ θ + cos⁶ θ) - 3(sin⁴ θ + cos⁴ θ) then the value of 3α such that cosalpha = sqrt{(3+A)/(5+A)} is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A = 2 (sin6 θ + cos6 θ) - 3 (sin4 θ + cos4 θ)

**Formula:**

(sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = (1 - 3 sin² θ cos² θ)

Proof:

(sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = (sin² θ + cos² θ) (sin⁴ θ + cos⁴ - sin² θ cos² θ)

⇒ (sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = 1 [(sin² θ + cos²)² - 3 sin² θ cos² θ]

⇒ (sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = (1 - 3 sin² θ cos² θ)

(sin4 θ + cos4 θ) = (1 - 2 sin2 θ cos2 θ)

Proof: 

⇒ (sin4 θ + cos4 θ) = [(sin2 θ + cos2)2 - 2 sin2 θ cos2 θ]

⇒ (sin4 θ + cos4 θ) = (1 - 2 sin2 θ cos2 θ)

**Calculation:**

A = 2 (sin6 θ + cos6 θ) - 3 (sin4 θ + cos4 θ)

⇒ A = 2 (1 - 3 sin² θ cos² θ) - 3 (1 - 2 sin2 θ cos2 θ) 

⇒ A = 2 - 6 sin² θ cos² θ - 3 + 6 sin² θ cos² θ

⇒ A = 2 - 3

⇒ A = - 1

Now,

cos α = √[(3 + A)/(5 + A)]

⇒ cos α = √[(3 - 1)/(5 - 1)]

⇒ cos α = √(2/4)

⇒ cos α = 1/√2

⇒ cos α = cos 45°

⇒ α = 45°

Now

3α

⇒ 3 × 45°

⇒ 135°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let θ = 90° 

A = 2(1 - 0) - 3(1 + 0)

So cos α = √2/4 = 1/√2

⇒ α = 45° 

∴ 3α = 135°

questions.question: If 117 Cos2 A + 129 Sin2 A = 120 and 170 Cos² B + 158 Sin² B = 161, then the value of Cosec² A Sec² B is:
questions.solution:

117 Cos2 A + 129 Sin2 A = 120 and 170 Cos2 B + 158 Sin2 B = 161

sin² A + cos² A = 1

cosec A = 1/sin A

sec A = 1/cos A

**Calculation:**

117 Cos2 A + 129 Sin2 A = 120 

⇒ 117 Cos2 A + 117 Sin2 A + 12 sin² A = 120

⇒ 117 + 12 sin² A = 120

⇒ 12 sin² A = 120 - 117

⇒ sin² A = 3/12

⇒ sin² A = 1/4

∴ cosec² A = 4

170 Cos2 B + 158 Sin2 B = 161

⇒ 12 cos² B + 158 Cos2 B + 158 Sin2 B = 161

⇒ 12 cos² B + 158 = 161

⇒ 12 cos² B = 161 - 158

⇒ cos² B = 3/12

⇒ cos² B = 1/4

∴ sec² B = 4

Now,

cosec² A sec² B

⇒ 4 × 4

⇒ 16

questions.question: A sells an item at 20% profit to B, and B sells the same at 10% profit to C and receives Rs. 1,32,000.0. Had C purchased the same item from A, he would have spent 5% less than what he spent with B. What profit would A have made when C purchased the same item from A?
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

CP = SP × [100/(100 + Profit)]

**Calculation:**

Cost price of the item for B = 1,32,000 × (100/110) = Rs. 1,20,000

Cost price of the items for A = 1,20,000 × (100/120) = Rs. 1,00,000

If C had purchased the items for A instead of B, then cost price for C = 1,32,000 × (95/100) = Rs. 1,25,400

∴ Profit of A = 1,25,400 - 1,00,000 = Rs. 25,400

questions.question: The distance between railway station is 1176 km. To cover this distance, an express train takes 5 hours less than a passenger train while the average speed of the passenger train is 70 km/h less than that of the express train. The time taken by the passenger train to complete the travel is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the **time** taken by the **passenger train** be T hours.

Speed of **passenger train** = 1176 / T

Speed of **express train** = 1176 / (T − 5)

Difference in speed: [1176 / (T − 5)] − [1176 / T] = 70

Testing option (3): If T = 12, then speed = 1176 / 12 = 98 km/h. Express speed = 1176 / 7 = 168 km/h.

Difference = 168 − 98 = 70 km/h. Condition satisfied.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Distance** = 1176 km, **Time difference** = 5 hours, **Speed difference** = 70 km/h.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a384914e635cbf2809c96a1e7691a115fef99044b41e6dfcf5a7b5e30c04837.png] 

⇒ Let time taken by **passenger train** = T

⇒ Speed of **passenger train** (Sₚ) = 1176 / T

⇒ Speed of **express train** (Sₑ) = 1176 / (T − 5)

⇒ Sₑ − Sₚ = 70

⇒ [1176 / (T − 5)] − [1176 / T] = 70

⇒ 1176 [ (T − (T − 5)) / (T(T − 5)) ] = 70

⇒ 1176 × 5 / (T² − 5T) = 70

⇒ 5880 = 70(T² − 5T)

⇒ 84 = T² − 5T

⇒ T² − 12T + 7T − 84 = 0

⇒ T(T − 12) + 7(T − 12) = 0

⇒ T = 12 (Time cannot be negative)

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

For a constant **distance**, **speed** is inversely proportional to **time** (S₁ / S₂ = T₂ / T₁).

Average Speed formula

When a distance is covered at different speeds, **Average Speed** = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Distance Formula for Speed Difference

Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) / (S₁ − S₂) ] × Time Difference.</p

Divisibility Las of 3: A number divisible by 3 if sum of its digit is divisible by 3.

**Calculation:**

Check option 1.

3,49,722 is divisible by 2 because unit digit of the number is 2.

3 + 4 + 9 + 7 + 2 + 2

27

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 12,000 was taken at simple interest at some rate. After four months, Rs. 6,000 more was added and the total principal was charged at double the earlier rate of interest. At the end of the year, if the total interest was Rs. 2,800, what was the initial rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

**Case-1**

Principal = 12,000

Rate = r%

Time = 4 month

**Case-2**

Principal = (12,000 + 6,000) = 18,000

Rate = 2r%

Time = 8 months

Total SI = Rs. 2800

**Formula:**

SI = Prt/100

**Calculation:**

According to the formula

2800 = [(12,000 × r × 4/12)/100] + [(18,000 × 2r × 8/12)/100]

⇒ 2800 = 40r + 240r

⇒ 280r = 2800

⇒ r = 2800/280

⇒ r = 10%

**∴ The initial rate of interest was 10%.**

questions.question: 5 men and 8 women can complete a task in 34 days, whereas 4 men and 18 women can complete the same task in 28 days. In how many days can the same task be completed by 3 men and 5 women?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

5 men and 8 women can complete a task = 34 days

4 men and 18 women can complete the same task = 28 days

**Formula:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let efficiency of 1 man and 1 woman be x and y respectively, then

(5x + 8y) × 34 = (4x + 18y) × 28

⇒ (5x + 8y) × 17 = (4x + 18y) 14

⇒ 85x + 136y = 56x + 252y

⇒ 85x - 56x = 252y - 136y

⇒ 29x = 116y

⇒ x/y = 116/29

⇒ x : y = 4 : 1

Total work = (5 × 4 + 8 × 1) × 34

Total work = (20 + 8) × 34

Total work = 28 × 34

Efficiency of 3 men and 5 women in 1 day = (3 × 4 + 5 × 1) = 12 + 5 = 17

∴ Time taken by 3 men and 5 women to complete the whole work = (28 × 34)/17 = 56 days
